description: Fetch and grade a domain's DMARC record at _dmarc.<domain>: policy (none/quarantine/reject), alignment modes, aggregate-report (rua) and failure-report (ruf) destinations, and the percentage applied. DMARC is what actually stops spoofing — p=none grades C even though most domains sit there. Use this when an agent needs to spoofing policy grade + report destinations. x402 price $0.02/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: security_dmarc_check
title: DMARC Policy Check
